```
maya chen: Nightly evals flagged a large regression between zh-Hans and zh-Hant prompt sets after the last quant pipeline run. sample failures look like context truncation + repetition at the switch to traditional characters. eval id: evals/nightly/2026-03-19/9876

eval-bot: nightly-evals summary
```
model: redwood-v2-small-quant-int8-2026-03-19
metric: chrF/bleu (zh-Hant): -11.8 / -9.4 vs baseline
metric: zh-Hans: -1.2 / -0.8
failing_prompts: 72/800 (zh-Hant)
note: spike coincides with runtime change rtm-2026-03-18 (tokenizer pad -> 1536)
```

simon ramos: @maya do we have the exact model artifact + quant config? int8 per-channel or per-tensor? also which runtime image pushed on 03-18?

li wei: we rolled two changes on 03-18:
- artifact: redwood-v2-small@sha256:0a1b2c3d
- quant: int8 per-channel, symmetric
- runtime: rtm-2026-03-18 (PR #4122) which unintentionally set max_context=1536 for fast-path tests

maya chen: here's one failing example (simplified -> expected traditional). prompt shortened for thread.
```
User prompt: "请将下列句子翻译为繁体中文：我们需要在下週二把報告交給主管。"
Expected: "請將下列句子翻譯為繁體中文：我們需要在下週二把報告交給主管。"
Model output: "請將下列句子翻譯為繁體中文：我們需要在下週二把報告交給主管。請將下列句子翻譯為繁體中文：我們需要在下週二把報告交給主管..."
Notes: output duplicates the prompt and then falls into short-loop repetition. appears only when original input contains mixed simplified/traditional tokens near 1500+ token boundaries.
```

juniper: sounds like a context-window mismatch between tokenizer indexing and runtime truncation. two quick reproductions:
1) rerun same artifact with max_context=2048 (old runtime) — if regression disappears, it's runtime-induced
2) rerun with quant disabled (float) — if disappears, quant interacts badly with KV cache shape

juniper: sample command:
```
./run_eval.sh --model redwood-v2-small@0a1b2c3d --max_context 2048 --prompt_set zh-hant-nightly
```

arjun: I'll kick off A/B jobs: int8-perc vs float, and runtime 1536 vs 2048. also will enable tokenizer debug mapping to log token ids at boundary. assigning to me, running now :eyes:

eval-bot: job scheduled: job_id=job-2026-03-19-5732, variants=[int8-1536,int8-2048,float-2048], expected run ~20m. will post results here.

maya chen: thanks — if we confirm runtime is culprit we should roll back rtm-2026-03-18 and add a regression test for mixed-simplified/traditional coverage at >1400 tokens.

simon ramos: agreed. @arjun please also dump kv-cache shapes for the bad runs. if quant kernel assumes different shape that could cause wrap/repeat bug.

arjun: got it. starting with kv dumps + tokenizer mapping. will report back with earliest failing seed.

eval-bot: last update: job-2026-03-19-5732 finished (partial). preliminary: float-2048 = baseline-like; int8-2048 improved but still -2.1 chrF vs baseline; int8-1536 reproduces -11.6. saving full logs: link: https://ci.redwood/evals/job-5732/logs

maya chen: perfect, that strongly points to the runtime context trim. let's hold the quant rollouts until we have a patch. @li can you open a rollback PR and add the regression unit test?

li wei: on it. creating PR now (#4180). will include test and a short patch to ensure tokenizer->runtime context config is read from model metadata, not default.

simon ramos: thumbs up. will coordinate with infra to hold the production rollout for quant-int8-perc until PR lands. :thumbsup:
